mechanism_narrative: The current FEDFUNDS level of 0.16% is below the historical 25th percentile, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to accommodative monetary policy transmission.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225.0 (as observed at t-2mo) indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in UNRATE and fall in PAYEMS (UNRATE > 0.3pp increase and PAYEMS > 1000 persons decline in 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.3pp increase AND PAYEMS > 1000 persons decline in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 1000 persons in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward 20-day returns due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: The current INDPRO level of 97.2853 (below 2017 base of 100) indicates industrial contraction, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in HOUST and RSAFS (HOUST > 0.5% and RSAFS > 0.5% increase in 1 month) signals strong consumer economy, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to increased consumer spending and business confidence.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0.5% AND RSAFS > 0.5% increase in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month.
